title: EvaluateBatchEvidenceAdmissibilityRequest
description: Request body for evaluateBatchEvidenceAdmissibility. A convenience primitive that MUST preserve the same semantics as repeated single evaluateEvidenceAdmissibility calls.

profileVersion.description: Optional pin to an exact grounding-profile version; supplied, the implementation MUST evaluate under that version or fail rather than substitute another. This operation MUST preserve the semantics of the single-evidence call, pinning included. No admission policy participates: admissibility is a function of ρ alone.
